fields.name: A moving dot in Aquarius
fields.blurb: A small patch of sky on the ecliptic, the path the planets follow, in the constellation Aquarius. SPHEREx photographed it again and again over two days in June 2025. Watch for the dot that jumps between frames.

fields.name: A second traveler in Aquarius
fields.blurb: One degree north of the first field, also on the ecliptic. Here SPHEREx caught a dot crossing the patch over about a day and a half in June 2025.

fields.name: A quiet patch in Aquarius
fields.blurb: A neighboring patch observed during the same two days, where the pipeline found nothing moving. Use it to see how stars change brightness from frame to frame only because each image is taken at a different infrared wavelength.
